ideas.summary_en: Explicitly states having taken positions and remains bullish on AI CPU demand growth
Repeated detailed bullish thesis on laser chokepoint, customer qualifications, CPO ramp; explicitly defending current position as undervalued
Explicitly states still waiting on volume ramp, indicating ongoing holding interest
Actively commenting on AI cloud infrastructure expansion announcement with positive framing
User currently holds AAOI, added at lows last year and maintains high conviction; still calls it his favorite US photonics name with 4-5x upside potential over 12-24 months once ATM pressure eases.

User has held long position in IQE since Feb 2026 entry at $12-13, now at $54, continues to list it among European longs with high conviction in photonics theme and remains positioned despite volatility.

User went long on LITE last year and continues to reference it positively in recent posts as a kingmaker in the photonics supercycle benefiting from AI capex and CPO/TAM growth, with no mention of exiting or turning bearish.

He originally posted a long $RPI thesis in February based on OpenClaw/agentic AI hardware hoarding driving material revenue impact on a small-cap company; this was validated by earnings (58% growth vs. 14% Street estimate) and he has repeatedly referenced it positively as part of his track record of validated European longs with no indication of exit.
User continues to hold and positively reference SOI as part of silicon photonics substrate monopoly thesis; remains up massively from entry with no signs of exit even after recent volatility.

User has publicly taken positions in XFAB, views current $1.28-1.5B market cap as deeply undervalued due to US/EU CHIPS Act subsidies, SiC/GaN power semi and silicon photonics growth, NVDA-related qualifications, extremely low P/B with government backing, making risk/reward compelling.
